name: Dubai Rentals & Flatmates
about: Practical renter conversations: viewings, Ejari questions, commute tradeoffs, and respectful flatmate searches.

stories.author: p69
stories.text: Viewing checklist: AC, water pressure, noise, and the actual commute.

stories.author: p39
stories.text: A clear written inventory prevents arguments later.

posts.author: p69
posts.text: New to Dubai and comparing a cheaper flat farther from work with a smaller place near the Metro. What tradeoff surprised you most after moving in?

comments.author: p17
comments.text: Calculate the full commute in summer, including the walk from the station. The cheaper rent can cost energy every day.

comments.author: p69
comments.text: That is exactly what I had not priced in. I will do two trial commutes before deciding.

comments.author: p25
comments.text: Also visit at night; construction noise and parking feel different after 8pm.

comments.author: p41
comments.text: Ask for every fee in writing and keep your own copy of the inventory.

posts.author: p39
posts.text: What do you photograph during a viewing before signing? I am making a one-page checklist for first-time renters.

comments.author: p90
comments.text: Meter readings, AC vents, window seals, water pressure, stains, and the exact parking bay.

comments.author: p39
comments.text: Adding all of those, plus a video of the appliances starting up.

comments.author: p52
comments.text: Photograph the view from each bedroom too; it catches unexpected construction sites.
